locator: The north part of 1828's street front from the north cheek of its canted bay to its north corner, porch, stoop and mansard; the right half shows the next house north, set back, its south flank and front; the print is torn on the right.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's own ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset, and the copy committed for the image gate (T-1887) is the store's, unaltered, with its attribution in the folder's README.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-26 (T-3166, piece 1 of T-1887) from the image store's reference copy, 387 x 675 px greyscale, sha256 c2b23da61891304ec9e26a3793b1ee7875a59cd816b51873e5cb684a28333334.
note: A view of 1828 from the north-east, nearer square-on to the porch than the automobile photograph: the canted bay's north cheek and front with one window per storey, carried up past the main cornice into the mansard, where it has its own dormer; the recessed north part of the front with one second-storey window over the porch; the porch's front arch on columns, its entablature and the balustrade on its top; the stoop between solid stone cheeks; a heavy cornice on brackets; the slated mansard with a dormer over the north part under a curved hood, and iron cresting on its curb. The stone of the front reads mottled in this print and smooth in the automobile photograph.
what_it_supplies: the second storey and the roof the automobile photograph cuts off: the mansard, its dormers, the cornice, the cresting
the bay carried up into the mansard
what_it_does_not_supply: the south part of the front, the flanks and the rear
